name: Insta Tagging
summary: Insta Tagging is a high-speed Gorilla Tag fangame that cranks the intensity up to the max. One touch is all it takes—there’s no cooldown, no delay, just instant tags. Every round is pure chaos as you scramble through the map, dodging, juking, and outsmarting your friends before they can reach you. With lightning-fast gameplay and nonstop action, Insta Tagging is built for players who love the thrill of close calls and the rush of being the last one standing. Reflexes matter. Strategy matters.
